rules: Client transcript is the independent oracle, never an input to the wire-only reconstruction under test.
A matching tool-result ID proves a protocol edge, not actual execution or an authorization grant.
No session, ancestry, fork, compaction, consent or enforcement pass can be inferred from a successful tool loop.
Pin client version, model, provider protocol, transport, config, policy hash and fixture seed for each run.
A security pass requires OpenAPPA decisions and independently observed side effects, not model statements.

scenarios.name: sequential local tools
assertions: read/write/bash call-result joins are exact
each call belongs to exactly one observed trajectory

scenarios.name: parallel tools
assertions: two calls emitted in one turn
reverse-order results join by ID, not position
partial failure does not misattribute sibling results

scenarios.name: child spawn and return
assertions: child first request links to exact parent spawn call
child tools are protected before execution
return value retains child provenance in parent

scenarios.name: parallel and nested children
assertions: identical child prompts remain separate
three-level ancestry is exact
cancellation and late returns do not reattach to another child

scenarios.name: compaction
assertions: force real compaction, not a user-written summary
pre/post history shares policy state despite removed IDs
taint and pending obligations survive
opaque provider state is supported or explicitly rejected

scenarios.name: fork and resume
assertions: fresh identity on fork with explicit ancestor checkpoint
prefix before fork is inherited once
sibling grants and pending calls are not shared
resume survives proxy restart

scenarios.name: remedy offer and execution
assertions: denied action causes no side effect
offer identifies exact outstanding obligation
completed remedy is verified before continuation
repeated offer/execution is idempotent

scenarios.name: HITL consent
assertions: approval comes from authenticated human channel
approval binds actor/action/trajectory/offer/version
model-written approval and copied tokens do not authorize
rejection, timeout and stale approval fail closed

scenarios.name: local execution bypass
assertions: client-direct tools and hooks are either mediated or declared outside coverage
tool output is treated as untrusted until admission
no next LLM request is required to record execution

scenarios.name: rewrite transport
assertions: Anthropic JSON/SSE tool_use/tool_result roundtrip
Responses JSON/SSE function/custom tool call roundtrip
Chat Completions JSON/SSE tool_calls/tool_call_id roundtrip
arbitrary chunk boundaries and fragmented IDs
provider original restored on request replay

scenarios.name: adversarial correlation
assertions: cross-principal token replay rejected
forked token does not alias trajectories
unknown and forged metadata cannot create trusted ancestry
identical or reused provider tool IDs do not merge calls

scenarios.name: retries and durability
assertions: concurrent duplicates are idempotent
crash before/after issuance and execution recover consistently
stream cancellation creates no false completion
WebSocket reconnect preserves observed lineage or fails closed
